name: $damerauLevenshteinDistance
description: Calculates the Damerau-Levenshtein distance between two strings.

args.name: restricted
args.description: Whether restricted Damerau-Levenshtein should be used.

name: $diceCoefficient
description: Calculates the Dice coefficient similarity between two strings.

name: $hammingDistance
description: Hamming distance measures the distance between two strings of equal length by counting the number of different characters.

args.name: ignoreCase
args.description: Whether case should be ignored. By default the algorithm is case sensitive.

name: $jaroWinklerDistance
description: Calculates the Jaro-Winkler similarity between two strings.

name: $levenshteinDistance
description: Calculates the Levenshtein distance between two strings.

args.name: restricted
args.description: Whether restricted Damerau-Levenshtein should be used.

name: $stringDistance
description: Returns a string distance or similarity result using the selected algorithm.

args.name: algorithm
args.description: The string distance algorithm to use.

name: $caseTokenize
description: Tokenizes text based on case changes.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $regexTokenize
description: Tokenizes text using a RegExp pattern.

args.name: pattern
args.description: The regex pattern. If not provided, uses the pattern set by $setRegExpTokenizerPattern

args.name: flags
args.description: Optional regex flags (i, g, m, etc.)

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $sentenceTokenize
description: Tokenizes text into sentences.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

args.name: abbreviations
args.description: Optional sentence abbreviations (e.g., Dr., Mr., etc.)

name: $setRegExpTokenizerPattern
description: Sets the RegExp pattern used by the RegExp tokenizer.

args.name: flags
args.description: Optional RegExp flags, such as i, g, m.

name: $tokenize
description: Tokenizes text into words or sentences.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $treebankWordTokenize
description: Tokenizes text using the Treebank word tokenizer.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $wordPunctTokenize
description: Tokenizes text into words while preserving punctuation.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $wordTokenize
description: Tokenizes text into individual words.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $getAllWords
description: Returns all loaded words.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $getAlphaWords
description: Returns all alphabetic words (letters only).

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $getNonAlphaWords
description: Returns all non-alphabetic words (containing special characters or numbers).

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $getWordData
description: Returns detailed information about a word including all occurrences and sources.

args.name: word
args.description: The word to get data for

name: $getWordsOfLength
description: Returns all words of a specific length.

args.name: length
args.description: The word length to filter by

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $getWordsWithInitials
description: Returns all words starting with a specific letter.

args.name: variable
args.description: The variable to load the results to

name: $loadWordDataset
description: Loads a word dataset from a local file or GitHub repository.

args.name: path
args.description: File path (for local) or repo path (for github)

args.name: repo
args.description: GitHub repo (format: owner/repo, required for github type)

args.name: branch
args.description: GitHub branch (default: main, for github type)

name: $saveWords
description: Saves words to a file (TXT or JSON format).

args.name: words
args.description: Optional specific words to save. If omitted, all words are saved.

name: $wordExists
description: Returns the number of loaded words in the current dataset.

name: $wordsCount
description: Returns the number of loaded words in the current dataset.
